name: @multiterm/pluto-workspace
description: Self-hosted runtime file platform with scoped sync, versioned storage, web administration, SDK, CLI, and MCP integrations.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-shared exec rune build && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-client exec rune build && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-server exec rune build && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-ui exec rune build && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-ui-shared exec rune build && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-site exec rune build && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-webui exec rune build && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto exec rune build && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/apps/mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-client exec rune test && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-server exec rune test && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto exec rune test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-client exec rune typecheck && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-server exec rune typecheck && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto exec rune typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p packages/apps/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-client exec rune lint && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-server exec rune lint
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-client exec rune format && pnpm --filter @multiterm/pluto-server exec rune format
